auth_findings: Bearer authentication scheme now accepts case-insensitive spelling; no new issuer or principal authority added.
Platform-verified X-Serverless-Authorization retains precedence over Authorization; Cloud Run IAM validation remains mandatory and application decoding is not independent JWT signature validation.
Issuer, numeric finite unexpired exp and bounded subject checks remain or strengthen previous rejection behavior.
Auth diagnostics print only finite operational reason codes, never credentials, subject, request text or media.
Exact-query record selection, confirmed manual/variant scope, admission limits, source/evidence gates and durable commit before complete-unit technical SSE are unchanged.

retention_findings.session_lifetime: Fixed expires_at = creation +24h; subsequent saves preserve original expires_at
retention_findings.idle_timeout: Sliding30min idle timeout bounded by fixed lifetime; does not extend 24h session retention
retention_findings.snapshot_expiry: Every immutable version inherits the same fixed session expiry
retention_findings.generic_versions_ttl: Not requested or approved by this review
retention_findings.usage_counters: Rolling24h admission counters with expiry refreshed by new admission; operational counters, not sliding session lifetime
retention_findings.immediate_access_control: load denies expired or idle-expired sessions before physical deletion; operation lookup rejects expired records
